findings.claim: Vale 在 20-F 自述：可使用較低品位鐵礦的技術可能降低其高品位產品組合的相對使用價值，對鐵礦產品需求與溢價造成負面影響；公司持續監控顛覆性技術。
findings.excerpt: Technologies that can allow the competitive use of lower grade iron ores could reduce the relative value in use of our higher-grade portfolio and have a negative impact on the demand and premium of our iron ore products. We continue to monitor disruptive technologies and market trends to deliver appropriate supply answers.
